name: FinBERT
description: Classifies English financial text as positive, negative, or neutral.
application: Explore tone analysis for financial communications and public reports, with human review.
limitation: Sentiment is not a fraud score, credit decision, price forecast, or investment recommendation.
licenseNote: The Hugging Face card does not explicitly specify a weights license. The linked code repository is Apache-2.0; confirm the applicable model and data terms before deployment.

name: BGE-M3
description: Multilingual embedding model supporting dense, sparse, and multi-vector document retrieval.
application: Explore semantic search across policies, product documentation, and financial reports as part of a retrieval-augmented workflow.
limitation: Retrieves relevant text; it does not generate verified answers or determine regulatory compliance. Financial-domain performance needs evaluation.
licenseNote: Model-card license: MIT. Review the full license and the permissions of the documents you index.

name: Granite Docling 258M
description: Compact document-conversion model that works with Docling to extract text, tables, and document structure.
application: Explore converting statements and reports into structured content for downstream document workflows.
limitation: Extraction can misread numbers or layouts. Reconcile figures against source documents; this is not an accounting or approval system.
licenseNote: Model-card license: Apache-2.0. Review the full license and evaluate your document-processing pipeline before deployment.
